text.description_html:
99" Track Stainless Steel Barn Door Kit Two Doors

This Stainless Steel 99 Inch Barn Door Kit for Double Doors comes with everything you need to install a sliding door. It comes packaged with a 99 inch track that is suitable for hanging two wood doors. The Delta 99D kit includes a stainless steel ball bearing wheel assembly to ensure an ultra-smooth, nearly silent operation. This sliding door mounting kit has a satin stainless steel finish that will add a contemporary touch to your home. And since it is made out of stainless steel, you can be certain it is designed to withstand the test of time, just like the unfailing appeal of the barn door itself.

Also Available: Delta Stainless Steel Barn Door Track Extension Kit

Features of the Sliding Barn Door Installation Kit:

  • Comes with all necessary hardware to install a wood barn door.
  • All 316 Marine Grade Stainless Steel Construction.
  • Nylon covered wheel for silent operation.
  • Ball bering wheel for a long lasting, smooth operation.

Specifications of the Modern Stainless Steel 99" Barn Door Hardware:

  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Track: 99"
  • For two doors.
  • AHI DELTA-99D Specifications Diagram (PDF)
  • AHI DELTA-99D Installation Guide (PDF)

Package Includes:

  • 1 Stainless Steel 99" Tubular Track
  • 2 Stainless Steel Wheel Sets
  • 1 Floor Guide
  • Wall Mounts
  • 2 Endcaps
  • All necessary installation hardware.

Special Order Item. NOT Returnable.
